item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01265","case1_error":"Treats 45 training days as 45 weeks, omitting division by five training days per week.","case2_error":"Subtracts the parent–child age difference from parents’ current age instead of subtracting Mark’s age.","reason":"The first fails to convert days to weeks; the second uses an incorrect age relation after correctly finding the age difference.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01266","case1_error":"Reverses the twice-as-many relation, multiplying Emmy’s remaining count by two to obtain Rosa’s count.","case2_error":"Assigns the friend’s 40% share to John instead of calculating John’s remaining 60%.","reason":"Reversing a multiplicative comparison differs from reporting another payer’s share instead of the requested payer’s complementary share.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01267","case1_error":"Writes correct group formulas, then introduces unsupported numbers and an extra summand to produce 112.","case2_error":"Uses 50 rather than 10 pages for the first group and incorrectly evaluates 50 × 5 × 30 as 750.","reason":"The first introduces unsupported totals after correct formulas; the second explicitly uses an incorrect input and incorrectly evaluates its written expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01268","case1_error":"Uses the first day’s total flower count, 50, as its tulip count instead of 30.","case2_error":"Treats the $1,000 commission as the tractor price and adds 20% instead of dividing by 20%.","reason":"Substituting an aggregate count for a category count differs from incorrectly recovering a whole price from its percentage commission.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01269","case1_error":"Counts Frank’s sold third as his remaining apples instead of subtracting it from his original count.","case2_error":"Omits the required $7 round-trip subway fare from the apple budget.","reason":"Confusing the removed amount with the remainder differs from omitting a required expense when calculating available funds.","judgment":"different"}]}
